input.quote: (a) Ono shall, and shall require its Affiliates to, permit Array, and/or an authorized representative reasonably acceptable to Ono, to enter the relevant facilities of Ono and its Affiliates during normal business hours and upon reasonable advance notice to inspect and verify compliance with applicable regulatory and other requirements, as well as with this Agreement, with respect to all matters relating to the Product
input.rationale: Two audit regimes bind us. Section 7.4 (p0481-p0482) is acceptable: inspections no more than once each Calendar Year, one inspection per quarter's records, by an independent accounting firm reasonably acceptable to Ono under a confidentiality agreement, at Array's expense unless underpayment exceeds a stated (redacted) threshold — at or near the preferred position. Section 4.9(a) (p0359), however, gives Array itself an unlimited-frequency right to enter Ono's and its Affiliates' facilities on merely "reasonable advance notice", with no independent auditor, no confidentiality undertaking, no cost allocation and no limit on access. That falls below the fallback and into walk-away territory, so we have made minimal edits requiring an independent auditor, one inspection per Calendar Year on 30 days' prior written notice at Array's cost unless an underpayment exceeding 5% is established, with a confidentiality undertaking, off-site inspection where possible and no direct access to Ono's systems; on-site access is otherwise retained given the GxP context.

ops.text: The auditor shall execute a reasonable confidentiality agreement prior to commencing any such inspection, the inspection shall be conducted off-site where possible, and it shall not include direct access to Ono's systems.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 4.9(a) currently lets Array itself inspect our facilities without limit on merely "reasonable" notice and at our cost, so we have limited inspections to an independent auditor, one per Calendar Year on 30 days' prior written notice at Array's cost (unless an underpayment exceeding 5% is established), and added the confidentiality, off-site and no-systems-access protections.
proposal.summary: Limit Section 4.9(a) inspections to an independent auditor, once per Calendar Year on 30 days' written notice at Array's cost, off-site where possible and with no direct systems access.
